Browse educational notebooks by scientific topic. Some accompany podcast episodes; others explore independent questions. Each resource includes its own background and code dependencies. When relevant, notebooks list related podcast episodes alongside standalone explanations and code.

## Published notebooks

Use the topic filters or search the table to find a resource. Topics reflect the published notebooks and expand as new content is added.

Notebook source code is available in the [GitHub repository](https://github.com/aelmokadem/pharmacometrics-podcast).
